entities.summary: Federico Elguera Seminario (1860–1928) was a Peruvian politician in the early 20th century. Elguera was born in Lima on 1 June 1860. He was the mayor of Lima from 1901 to 1908 and Ambassador to Bolivia from 1911 to 1912.
